author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
I present another map for Avicus, called "Knuckles and Broken Goggles". This resembles a sports bar and while it is not a large size, it can support a 15v15 (30 players) total. From bathrooms, to bars, to slot machines, to pool tables, to air hockey... it has a lot of features. It is a team deathmatch and your goal is to kill the enemy team before time runs out.

It's Yellow vs. Orange, and you spawn in the bar room (marked with a wool).

Authors: ParaSpider and Evocal
